title: SneakerWatch Announces Free Nike Gift Card Giveaway
description: http://www.sneakerwatch.com/ - SneakerWatch is giving away a free Nike Gift card this week to show appreciation to people who actively use our Facebook. Be sure to get everyone you know involved to increase your chances at winning a $100 to buy whatever you choose at any Nike shop. Follow the instructions below to qualify.  1.) Like our Facebook page (https://www.facebook.com/SneakerWatch)  2.) Like our Facebook Contest post (Share the post to increase your visibility) https://www.facebook.com/SneakerWatch/posts/970710129626303  3.) Tag a friend under our FB contest Post   We will announce the winner of the gift card on Tuesday, July 7th at 12PM.    https://www.facebook.com/SneakerWatch

asr.full_text: What's good Sneaker Watchers? If you're looking to cop some gear or some. Sneakers for pretty much free, then we have the perfect opportunity for you. We. Will be giving away a free $100 Nike gift card to one follower who actively. Participates on our page. All you have to do is head over to our Facebook page. Facebook.com slash Sneaker Watch. Once you've done that, like our page, like our. Facebook contest post and tag a friend under the post. We'll announce the winner of the contest one week from today at noon on July 7th. Thanks for participating, sneaker watchers. Head over to our page now to get your chance at winning a free gift card. No fucking Travel Fox. And I ain't like hot techs. They wasn't sneakers, but they was boots. I ain't like niggas that wore hot techs back in the day. It's just as weak. I ain't like that high tech look. Get out of here with some high tech. You couldn't even, you couldn't come through, you couldn't move with me if you had on high techs, as a matter of fact. Honestly, do what you want to do, but just personally, if you're buying sneakers, just hold on to them and not ever wear them. And then eventually sell them down the road. Somebody eventually wants that sneaker to wear.
